sourceEvidence.title: Quality Manager
sourceEvidence.quote:
## Job Overview by Ladders
Qualifications
* 7+ years of experience in Quality Engineering or related roles
* 3-5 years in Semiconductor or Manufacturing environments
* Bachelor's degree in mathematics, statistics, physics, chemistry, material science, engineering, or equivalent
* ASQ Certified Quality Engineer or Six Sigma Black Belt certification preferred
* Strong problem-solving skills with a focus on root cause analysis
* Familiarity with quality systems and auditing processes, including ISO 9001 & ISO 14001
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
